summary: Fix ProductSet subset checks against FiniteSet by rewriting explicit finite factors into tuple elements. Add symmetric ProductSet/FiniteSet equality dispatch using mutual subset checks, fixing the reported Eq simplification exception. Add regressions for the reported example, both equality directions, unevaluated Eq simplification, missing/extra points, symbolic uncertainty, nested products, and infinite products. Reproduced original None/AttributeError and observed new regression fail before fix; regression passes after fix. Public command /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python bin/test sympy/sets/tests sympy/core/tests/test_relational.py --no-colors --no-subprocess: 252 passed, 8 expected failures. git diff --check passed. Rewrite intentionally applies when factors rewrite to explicit FiniteSets; no claim of arbitrary symbolic finite-set enumeration.
